newsitem.title: USA: InterVoice shrs fall after Q3 EPS outlook.
newsitem.headline: InterVoice shrs fall after Q3 EPS outlook.

text.p: Shares of InterVoice Inc dropped on Thursday after the company said it expected third quarter earnings to fall below expectations.

The company, which supplies automated call processing systems, said late Wednesday it expected earnings to be between $0.07 per share and $0.09 per share, after after an adjustment for a litigation reserve of about $1.3 million, net of taxes. It said it expects earnings per share to be between $0.15 and $0.17 before the adjustment. In the year ago period it earned $0.27 per share.
Prudential Securities downgraded the stock to a hold from a buy recommendation, a source at the brokerage said.
The shares closed unofficially off 3-1/4 at 11-5/8.
